rules.bestEverydayBuy: Rank lowest effective unit cost among verified adequate-quality options, including store brands; separate exact identical-item comparisons from functional equivalents. Require current verified price, pack size, dosing, conditions, availability. Never claim universal best for an entire category without evidence.
rules.deal: Exact SKU and verified all-in NL price, independent comparator or price history, genuine >=10% discount, show absolute EUR saving and percentage.
rules.exceptionalDeals: Prioritize high absolute EUR saving plus personal relevance and quality; do not promote percentage alone.
rules.loyalty: Show member-only prices and conditions separately
rules.qualityThreshold: Adequate functionality, correct use, reputable product safety, suitable dosage. Unknown quality -> label uncertain, do not claim best buy.

buyerPreference.primary: Lowest effective cost per use for an adequately performing product
buyerPreference.quality: Minimum acceptable quality; evaluate basic effectiveness, dosage, durability and safety/fit for purpose before price ranking
decisionOrder: meets minimum quality and correct intended use
buyerPreference.brandPreference: None by default; store brands and budget brands compete equally
buyerPreference.avoid: Cheap but ineffective products, misleading bulk pack calculations and unsupported equivalence
buyerPreference.evidence: Qualitative comparisons require a stated basis; no fabricated lab tests or quality scores
